### Rithm Capital Corp. Schedules Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call


October 12, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s25.q4cdn.com/437555238/files/doc_news/Rithm-Capital-Corp--Schedules-Third-Quarter-2026-Earnings-Release-and-Conference-Call-2026.pdf)


NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Rithm Capital Corp. (NYSE: RITM, “Rithm Capital,” “Rithm” or the “Company”) announced today that it will release its third quarter 2026 financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026, on Friday, October 23, 2026, prior to the opening of the New York Stock Exchange. In addition, management will host a conference call that same day at 8:00 a.m. Eastern Time.


A copy of the earnings release will be posted to the Shareholders – Events & Presentations section of the Company’s website,[www.rithmcap.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.rithmcap.com&esheet=54620446&newsitemid=20261012213742&lan=en-US&anchor=www.rithmcap.com&index=1&md5=2c257a1da82a6a5751c0533d1da9c5bb) . The webcast of the conference call may be accessed at[https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/976436235](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fattendee%2F976436235&esheet=54620446&newsitemid=20261012213742&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fattendee%2F976436235&index=2&md5=46cac9a6f2f58ede0dcf2ce529a37cdb) . Please allow extra time prior to the call to visit the website and download any software required to listen to the internet broadcast. In addition, participants are encouraged to pre-register for the conference call at[https://events.q4inc.com/analyst/976436235?pwd=0lyfjeVL](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fanalyst%2F976436235%3Fpwd%3D0lyfjeVL&esheet=54620446&newsitemid=20261012213742&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fanalyst%2F976436235%3Fpwd%3D0lyfjeVL&index=3&md5=c9bda81aad3e23a9ee3a089995b6245c) .


An audio replay of the conference call will also be available two hours following the call’s completion through 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time on Friday, October 22, 2027, in the Events & Presentations section of the Company’s website or using the same link as the webcast at[https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/976436235](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fattendee%2F976436235&esheet=54620446&newsitemid=20261012213742&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fattendee%2F976436235&index=4&md5=cb90fd1592f65ada3fb714b76db88958) .


**About Rithm Capital**


Rithm Capital Corp. (NYSE: RITM) is a New York-based global alternative asset manager with deep experience across credit, real estate, and other alternative strategies. The firm pairs institutional expertise with an entrepreneurial culture that looks for opportunity early and pursues it with discipline. Rithm combines an asset management platform with a family of operating companies, giving it direct insight into many of the markets in which it invests. That owner-operator approach is built to deliver enduring performance for clients, partners, and shareholders. For more information, visit[www.rithmcap.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.rithmcap.com&esheet=54620446&newsitemid=20261012213742&lan=en-US&anchor=www.rithmcap.com&index=5&md5=090eb4b317f10917f1255633b7d95078)
